# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## Overview
Project Maya is an open-source (MIT) local inference engine for running three large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware: **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B, 18B active), **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** (748B), and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** (428B, 23B active). Created by Peasant Smith (@mw00), co-maintained by @needmorevram.

## Core Architecture
- **Tiered expert storage:** Hot experts stay in
